fields.name: alpha
fields.description: Beta distribution success count (prior + observed successes).

fields.name: beta
fields.description: Beta distribution failure count (prior + observed failures).

fields.name: intervalLow
fields.description: Lower bound of the last computed credible interval.

fields.name: intervalHigh
fields.description: Upper bound of the last computed credible interval.

fields.name: observations
fields.description: Number of observations folded into the posterior so far.

events.name: MASTERY_REACHED
events.description: The posterior mean clears masteryFloor with a credible interval narrow enough to trust.

events.name: REMEDIATION_NEEDED
events.description: The posterior mean is at or below remediationCeiling with a credible interval narrow enough to trust.

events.name: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
events.description: The abstain — the credible interval is still wider than intervalWidthMax, so no verdict is licensed yet.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max credible-interval width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Above this width the posterior is too uncertain to decide — abstain with EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Mastery floor
overridableConfigKeys.description: Posterior mean at or above this, with a tight interval, licenses MASTERY_REACHED.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Prior alpha
overridableConfigKeys.description: Beta prior success pseudo-count before any observation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Prior beta
overridableConfigKeys.description: Beta prior failure pseudo-count before any observation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Remediation ceiling
overridableConfigKeys.description: Posterior mean at or below this, with a tight interval, licenses REMEDIATION_NEEDED.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Posterior sample count
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of Monte Carlo draws from the Beta posterior used to estimate the credible interval.
